Walkthrough

The Redis circuit breaker now opens after two connection failures within ten seconds. The connection pool can retry eligible reads once with a fresh client. The Redis session handler uses this retry path for GET operations. **Changes: Redis read resilience** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Circuit breaker strike threshold**
`src/Redis/RedisCircuitBreaker.php`, `tests/Unit/Redis/RedisCircuitBreakerTest.php`|The breaker records a first connection failure and opens after a second failure within ten seconds. A successful call clears the recorded strike. Tests cover the threshold, timing, and related breaker scenarios.| |**Idempotent session reads**
`src/Redis/RedisConnectionPool.php`, `src/Session/RedisSessionHandler.php`, `tests/Unit/Redis/OneDeadSocketDoesNotCostTheReadTest.php`|The pool adds a one-retry read method and an optional client factory. Session GET operations use the retry method. Tests cover read retry, retry failure, and the absence of retries for writes.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~20 minutes **Change:** Bug fix ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant RedisSessionHandler participant RedisConnectionPool participant RedisCircuitBreaker participant RedisClient RedisSessionHandler->>RedisConnectionPool: withIdempotentRead for GET RedisConnectionPool->>RedisCircuitBreaker: first attempt through withConnection RedisCircuitBreaker->>RedisClient: execute read RedisClient-->>RedisConnectionPool: ConnectionException RedisConnectionPool->>RedisConnectionPool: discard idle clients RedisConnectionPool->>RedisCircuitBreaker: retry through withConnection RedisCircuitBreaker->>RedisClient: execute read on fresh client RedisClient-->>RedisSessionHandler: return read result ```
Merge Risk: Low · up to 68897

After a Redis restart, concurrent session reads on stale connections can briefly be refused even though a fresh connection would work. Those requests may get guest sessions for a short window. This looks narrow and transient, and it is largely consistent with the documented fail-fast design. Owners should be aware of it, and a concurrent-read test would help, but it does not block the merge.

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title states the main change: one Redis read error no longer opens the circuit breaker or turns the request into a guest session. The changeset adds a two-failure threshold within 10 seconds, an idempotent read retry on a fresh client, and tests for both. The title matches the stated incident and the primary behavior change. Writes are not retried, which the title does not mention, but that is a secondary detail.
